interpretation: Same-session pooled p50 improves by about 5.8 ms. Independent cold source batches are mixed. The full-scene Mac p50/p95 is 37.5/58.1 ms and is close to the previous 37.6/57.2 ms probe, so no universal latency reduction or sub-30-ms claim is made.
